body.translated_text: The Noble <s>Āryasāgaranāgarājaparipṛcchā</s> (Questions of Sāgara, the Nāga King), a <s>Mahāyānasūtra</s> (Great Vehicle Scripture) = <s>Sāgara</s> in Sanskrit
Recovered again. Homage to all <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bodhisattvas</s>.

body.text: evaṃ mayā śrutam - ekasmin samaye bhagavān buddhaḥ sāgaranāgarājāvasathe viharati sma sārddhaṃ sārdhadvādaśaśatabhikṣūṇāṃ mahāsaṅghena bahubhiśca bodhisattvamahāsattvaiḥ / tasmin samaye bhagavān buddhaḥ sāgaranāgarājamavocat - nāgādhipate, caturṇāṃ dharmoddānānāmabhidhāne kriyamāṇe tadabhidhānena caturaśītidharmaskandhasahasrāṇāmabhidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati / katamāni catvāri? tathāhi -
body.translated_text: Thus have I heard — At one time, the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One), the <s>Buddha</s>, was dwelling in the abode of <s>Sāgaranāgarāja</s> (Sāgara, the Nāga King), together with a great assembly of twelve hundred and fifty <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks) and many <s>Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas</s> (great bodhisattva beings). At that time, the <s>Bhagavān Buddha</s> spoke to <s>Sāgaranāgarāja</s>: "O Lord of <s>Nāgas</s>, when the exposition of the four <s>dharmoddānas</s> (dharma summaries) is made, by that exposition, the exposition of eighty-four thousand <s>dharmaskandhas</s> (aggregates of dharma) is accomplished. What are these four? They are as follows —"
In the impermanence of all <s>saṃskāras</s> (conditioned formations), the inexhaustible knowledge taught by the <s>Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas</s> operates.
In the suffering nature of all <s>dharmas</s> with outflows (<s>sāsrava</s>), the inexhaustible knowledge taught by the <s>Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas</s> operates.
In the selflessness of all <s>dharmas</s>, the inexhaustible knowledge taught by the <s>Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas</s> operates.
In the peace of <s>Nirvāṇa</s>, the inexhaustible knowledge taught by the <s>Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas</s> operates.

body.text: nāgādhipate, eteṣāṃ caturṇāṃ dharmoddānānāmabhidhāne kriyamāṇe tadabhidhānena caturaśītidharmaskandhasahasrāṇāmabhidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati /
body.translated_text: O Lord of <s>Nāgas</s>, when the exposition of these four <s>dharmoddānas</s> (dharma summaries) is made, by that exposition, the exposition of eighty-four thousand <s>dharmaskandhas</s> (aggregates of dharma) is accomplished.

body.text: idamavocat bhagavān / āttamanaso bhikṣavaḥ sarve ca bodhisattvā bhagavato bhāṣitamabhyanandanniti /
body.translated_text: Thus spoke the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One). The <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks), with joyful minds, and all the <s>Bodhisattvas</s> rejoiced at the words of the <s>Bhagavān</s>.
The Noble <s>Mahāyānasūtra</s> called the <s>Āryasāgaranāgarājaparipṛcchā</s> (Questions of Sāgara, the Nāga King) is completed.
